sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 76 Pinon A-D sites, read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/sites/default/files/dam/zfkfimxlrt/lathrop-state-park-brochure.pdf ('Each site is equipped with 20, 30 and 50 amp electric') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lathrop-state-park/lathrop-state-park-camping-lodging ('up to 50-amp electrical hook-ups') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (all 76 Pinon sites 'Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50', no water or sewer hookup listed), read 2026-10-27

values.note: CPW counts 82 sites; the booking site lists 76 individual electric sites in loops A-D (A 20, B 18, C 14, D 24), 69 of them pull-through. Paved. Vehicle lengths 25-75 ft, mostly 40-55; two sites (039, 051) take 25 ft.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/sites/default/files/dam/zfkfimxlrt/lathrop-state-park-brochure.pdf ('Piñon Campground features 82 sites with pull-through parking spaces') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lathrop-state-park/lathrop-state-park-camping-lodging ('pull-through or back-in paved sites, paved roads') + cpwshop campsiteDetails for the 76 sites (Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/sites/default/files/dam/zfkfimxlrt/lathrop-state-park-brochure.pdf ('electrical hook-ups, flush toilets, tent pads, shower houses, a playground'; 'The campground has a dump station and water hydrants'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Winter amenities are limited to toilets; call the visitor center (719-738-2376) about what is open.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lathrop-state-park/lathrop-state-park-camping-lodging ('Open year-round, Lathrop's two campgrounds have 103 sites'; 'Camping is available year-round at Lathrop. Contact the park Visitor Center at 719-738-2376 to inquire about amenities available during the winter months'; 'Winter amenities: Toilets') + cpwshop Pinon sites 'Status: Open year round.' and priced for Jan 12, 2027, read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, from the day of arrival up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lathrop-state-park/lathrop-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Lathrop State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + 2024 brochure ('All campsites are by reservation only. Sites may be reserved on the day of arrival or up to 6 months in advance'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Piñon electric sites $36 a night in January and June, a Saturday the same. Aspen Leaf passholders get $3 off Sunday-Thursday. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, arrival Tue Jan 12, 2027 and Sat Jun 19, 2027 (Pinon A-D Electric '$36.00 /Per Night') + 2024 brochure ('Piñon Electric - $36/night'; 'Aspen Leaf passholders receive $3.00 discount Sunday - Thursday nights, excluding holidays') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lathrop-state-park ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15'), read 2026-10-27

note: Paved campground on the north side of Martin Lake at Lathrop (Colorado's first state park) near Walsenburg, within walking distance of the lake, the Hogback Trail and the adjoining nine-hole golf course. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + 2024 brochure + every cpwshop Pinon site page: confirmed 82 sites, 20/30/50-amp electric, pull-throughs, showers, dump, year-round, $36, phone. Added max rig 75 ft, flush toilets and water hydrants, winter-toilets note, deep link, 180-day window, fcfs never, 14-night max, Aspen Leaf discount.
